PART I
Item 1. Business

The Company designs smartphones, personal computers, tablets and wearables, and sells services.

The Company manages its business on a geographic basis. Its reportable segments are the Americas, Europe, Greater China, Japan and Rest of Asia Pacific.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

The Company’s operations and performance depend significantly on global and regional economic conditions.

The Company depends on component and product manufacturing in Greater China and elsewhere.

PART II
Item 7. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations

Total net sales increased 6% during 2025 compared to 2024, driven by higher net sales of iPhone and Services.

Greater China net sales decreased 4% during 2025 compared to 2024.

Item 7A. Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures About Market Risk

The Company is exposed to interest rate and foreign exchange risk.

Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data

Segment information: Americas net sales were $178,353 million in 2025.
